_comment: Pensacola — generation-A workbook. IMPORTED 2026-08-01 (16 listings, 8 published). Re-geocoded 2026-08-04: 3 held rows recovered to high precision, taking the split to 11 published / 5 held. envelope was set 2026-07-31 from the MSA county list, not from the observed bbox — see _envelope_comment.
_envelope_comment: Derived from the Pensacola-Ferry Pass-Brent, FL MSA COUNTY LIST, not from the observed venue bounding box. The observed bbox is only a LOWER bound — it says where the venues we happened to find are, not where the metro is, so an envelope cut to it would reject a legitimate future venue near the metro edge. Envelope = the union of the OSM boundary-polygon bounding boxes for the 2 MSA counties (Escambia, Santa Rosa), Santa Rosa (Florida)), rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg. Cross-check: contains all 8 geocoded venue(s) of 16 in this batch (observed lat 30.3547..30.6397, lng -87.2238..-86.8504).
msa: Pensacola-Ferry Pass-Brent, FL (Escambia, Santa Rosa counties)
_expected_publish_comment: Added 2026-08-04. The original import had NO expected_publish block, which is exactly why an 8-of-16 split published quietly and unasserted — the run had nothing to diverge from. Both --stage=project (from the artifact) and --stage=publish (from the database) assert against this, so a future run that classifies even one row differently FAILS instead of publishing a plausible-looking number. If a hold below is resolved, move the row out of this map deliberately; never edit the map to match an output.

_released_2026_08_05.highpoint-park-gulf-breeze-fl: PUBLISHED 2026-08-05. Was held on `coordinate precision low`, which ADR-16 retired as a gate condition — the row now publishes behind a user-visible approximate-location label rather than being withheld. The evidence gap recorded below is unchanged and still real: the cited Gulf Breeze page prints no street address, so the coordinate remains an honest street-band value. ADR-16's position is that a labelled approximate pin serves a reader better than no venue at all; the satellite check would still improve the row.

_hold_reasons.portside-pickle-pensacola-fl: Tier-1 address added 2026-08-04 (740 Commendencia St). OSM has no house number 740 on Commendencia Street and the venue name is absent entirely; best anchor is the street centerline, which is low.
_hold_reasons.pensacola-athletic-center-pensacola-fl: Absent from OSM. Three sourced corridor aliases each resolve to a DIFFERENT road; the no-city rung returned four West Highway 98 segments 50.7-51.8 km away, all rejected by the 5,000 m guard.
_hold_reasons.navarre-beach-recreation-center-pickleba: UNTOUCHED BY INSTRUCTION — suspected duplicate of lenny-james-tolbert-memorial-park-navarre-fl, and an owner decision. Not researched, not geocoded, not merged, not deleted.
_hold_reasons.lenny-james-tolbert-memorial-park-navarr: No house number 3124 on Bob Tolbert Road in OSM. The name-variant sweep found only two Jacksonville venues ~500 km away, correctly rejected by the locus guard.
